The structure of Lu2Co4Te8 (Lu(CoTe2)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co centers in octahedral environments with six Te neighbors, while Lu centers have eight Te neighbors and Te centers have nine neighbors (four Co, two Lu, three Te). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Te polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
